title: Climate change mitigation for late industrialisers: technology intensity in manufacturing
outlet: SARChI Industrial Development Policy Brief 2023-01 (with CBDS, Copenhagen Business School)
summary: Late industrialisers need manufacturing to grow, but heavy industrialisation can raise emissions. Drawing on evidence from 56 developing economies, the brief asks whether greener industrial policy, shifting towards higher-technology manufacturing, lets countries industrialise while limiting emissions.
